observations: Three retail boxes for Zyre Dry Irons are stacked vertically.
The boxes feature a blue and white dry iron illustration.
Text on the box identifies the brand as 'ZYRE' and the product as 'DRY IRON with Teflon Soleplate'.
Technical specifications on the box include '1200W', '50/60Hz', and '220-240V'.
A '1 Year Warranty' seal is printed on the top right of each box.
The actual irons are not visible outside of their packaging.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty or contain a different, inferior item.
risks.proof: A photo of the iron out of the box next to the packaging.

risks.risk: The iron may be non-functional or have electrical defects.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron plugged in with the power indicator light on and heating up.

risks.risk: The Teflon soleplate may be scratched or damaged, affecting performance.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the soleplate surface.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual iron outside the box.
Video of the iron powered on and heating up.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by its retail packaging. It is priced as a non-functional unit because only the boxes are shown without proof of the contents or their condition.
